name: Mo' Bettahs (Logan, Draper & Orem, UT) Grilled Teriyaki Chicken with White Steamed Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Utah Locations)
whyItWorks: Flame-grilled boneless skinless chicken thighs marinated in sweet teriyaki glaze, served over fluffy steamed white rice. Tender, low-residue, and soothing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mini or Regular Teriyaki Chicken Plate with double white rice (substitute extra white rice for the macaroni salad if dairy/mayo sensitive).
watchOuts: Macaroni salad contains mayonnaise and gluten; substitute extra white rice if sensitive
